reviews.subject: fix(cdk/stepper): allow signal form to be assigned as stepControl (#33562)
reviews.decision: Complete seven-path patch read: contrary to the filtered markdown seed, this includes production CdkStep/CdkStepper and public declaration changes. StepControl widens AbstractControl to Field, and valid/invalid/pending/reset operations branch on callable field values; linear navigation and completed/error behavior are affected. Authentic pinned CDK21.2.14 declares AbstractControl, while22.1.7 declares the union. The add-on owns stepper Sass but delegates ordinary stepper behavior. No modern API mirror or younger21.x peer is authorized. Reopen main prior irrelevant disposition: public AbstractControl navigation/completion/error/reset compatibility on both minimum peers still needs individual behavior evidence before terminal disposition. Signal-form support absent at21 minimum is not itself a legacy regression.
reviews.behavior_qualification: not-executed; pending independent AbstractControl transition/reset probes on both pinned peers
